notes: The EGP 480,000 is not cash: every page describes it as a services package for marketing, HR, legal and technical support, so the usable compute is the separate USD 10,000 AWS credit. Whether a company is required is unresolved: no page read names an incorporation document, and the published exclusion is only that undergraduates cannot apply. The round is open for an October 2026 intake according to a third-party tracker at a 31 October 2026 deadline, while ITIDA's own incubation page states no deadline, and two other pages carry different dates, one closing 1 August 2026 and one describing a 2027 cohort beginning 1 January 2027. The date discrepancy is the finding to carry forward: the rounds are frequent enough that a reader should check ITIDA's own press releases rather than any aggregator.
